clues: This town is in New Zealand. It sits on the west shore of Tasman Bay.
This area gets very high sunshine hours each year. It ranks near the top in the whole country.
Until the early 1980s, this was the main place for growing tobacco. No other area in the country led that crop.
The land around town grows apples, pears and kiwifruit in orchards. Some farms also grow hops there.
A short trip away lies Kaiteriteri beach. Crowds of holiday folk flock there for breaks.
